verdicts.reason: HOL4 has five antecedents (q has_type Bool, term_ok q, the semantic premise on p1/p2, and both entailments). Lean keeps only is_set_theory mem, with p1 and p2 unused, and claims (thy, term_union h1 h2) entails q for all inputs. entails0 requires theory_ok thy, has_type q BoolTy and hypset_ok, which fail for e.g. q = Abs (Const n ty) p. The statement is false whenever is_set_theory holds, unlike HOL4's theorem. The conventions do not license this.
